knowledge-base.overview: Dart Frog 1.x guardrails, file-based routing, middleware cascade, dependency injection via provider/context.read, error handling, models with freezed, and testing. Applies to Dart REST APIs, full-stack Flutter+Dart projects, and serverless backends. Route files must export a top-level onRequest function. Middleware files named _middleware.dart apply to their directory subtree.

core-principles.principle: Route structure mirrors the filesystem under routes/. routes/api/v1/users/[id].dart maps to /api/v1/users/:id automatically.
onRequest functions dispatch by HTTP method and delegate to services. Never embed business logic in route files.
_middleware.dart files apply from outermost directory to innermost. Global middleware runs first (logging, CORS, error handler, DI wiring).
Use provider<T>() in middleware and context.read<T>() in route handlers. No service locators, no singletons, no global state.
All errors return JSON bodies via a global error-handler middleware. Never expose stack traces or raw exception messages in production.

guardrail.rule: Every route file must export a top-level onRequest function matching the required signature. Missing onRequest causes a compile error.
Always return 405 Method Not Allowed for unsupported HTTP methods. Never silently ignore unknown verbs.
Register providers from least-dependent to most-dependent in middleware. Config must be registered before Database; Database before Repository; Repository before Service.
Never hardcode secrets. Load all configuration from Platform.environment via Config.fromEnvironment(). Register Config as the first provider in global middleware.
Use a global error-handler middleware that catches all exceptions and returns structured JSON. Never let exceptions propagate to the Shelf layer unhandled.
Keep route handler methods thin — under 20 lines. Any handler exceeding this is embedding business logic that belongs in a service.
Use HttpStatus constants (HttpStatus.ok, HttpStatus.created, etc.) instead of raw integer literals. Magic numbers obscure intent.
Use parameterized queries for all database access. Never interpolate user input into SQL strings.
Mirror test file paths to route file paths. routes/api/v1/users/index.dart tests live in test/routes/api/v1/users/index_test.dart.
Run dart format . and dart analyze before every commit. The dart_frog build will fail on analysis errors.
Set CORS allowed origins to explicit domains in production middleware. Never use wildcard * origins.
